name: the assumed meaning gets struck through
looks: A short equation-like statement names the mark's assumed, narrow meaning. A hand-drawn-style line strikes straight through that meaning, and it is replaced by a small glowing question mark sitting right where the old meaning was, undercutting the assumption in one beat.
build: DOM text sets the claim before the strike so nothing reflows; a single stroke draws across the struck phrase (strokeDashoffset, 200-300ms, slight hand wobble); the struck phrase drops opacity and is swapped for a glowing question-mark glyph in the same position.
sound: A single marker-pen scribble as the strike draws on, a soft chime as the question mark settles.
prompt: State the audience's assumption as a short, confident claim, then strike a single line through the part that's wrong and replace it with a bare question mark in the same spot -- one beat that turns a confident assumption into an open question.
